text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert — service=redwood-infer api=generate (us-west-2a). Spike in 5xx and tail latency > 2s. AlertID=ALRT-1767504321. Link: https://pager.redwood.internal/alerts/ALRT-1767504321

alice: ack — i'm oncall. taking lead. starting triage and surface root nodes.

ben: seeing RX/TX drops on g5s in node-group gw-infer-prod-usw2a. dmesg shows 'NETDEV WATCHDOG: eth0: transmit queue 0 timed out' and repeated 'tx timeout'.

alice: nice find. what's impact? percent errors?

ben: ~18% 5xx across the fleet behind the us-west-2a routing pool, top of stack shows grpc errors -> reset. CPU/GPU fine, network errors coincide with time window.

devon: starting traffic shift to fallback model variant (rdx-small-v2) for affected routes. command: ```
# shift routing policy
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.redwood.internal/v1/routing/shift" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"from_pool":"usw2a-primary","to_pool":"eu-west-1-fallback","percent":40}'
```

carla: support here — creating high-priority tickets for customers seeing errors. top 5 customers flagged; drafting status page update. ETA to publish notice 10m.

emily: CS team will notify enterprise accounts with estimated SLO exposure. Leave me a line when we know duration.

ben: also seeing resolver timeouts from instances: dig @169.254.169.253 A api.redwood.internal -> some queries timing out intermittently. Could be resolver jitter at egress.

frank: run traceroute from an affected host: ```
traceroute api.redwood.internal
 1  10.0.0.1  0.5 ms
 2  100.64.5.1  1.2 ms
 3  * * *  (packets dropped)
 4  52.95.142.10  12 ms
```
Looks like egress path flapping or middlebox dropping UDP/DNS. Opening provider ticket with packet captures.

alice: mitigation plan: 1) shift 40% traffic to eu-west-1 (devon initiated), 2) increase cache TTL for common prompt prefixes to reduce resolver pressure, 3) enable model fallback variant for high-error routes, 4) engage provider support for us-west-2a egress jitter.

incident-bot: Runbook executed: cross-region fallback enabled, caching hints applied. Monitoring jobs: 30s latency checks and 1m error-rate windows.

ben: after shift, 5xx dropped to ~3% within 12 minutes for routed traffic. Remaining 60% still shows intermittent resets.

frank: provider acknowledged ticket, notes probable transient peering issue. They will route around affected path; ETA initial update 20m.

alice: oncall handoff scheduled — i'll stay on for 30m, then hand to frank if still active. tagging #incidents for continuous updates.

carla: status page update posted: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/1767504321 — customers notified.

emily: thanks, i'm sending targeted emails now.

alice: update at +28m: metrics improving, tail latency down, errors trending toward baseline. keeping channel open for monitoring and postmortem. postmortem owner: ben.

carla: assigning customer follow-ups to support owners. closing the customer-impact notification loop.

alice: closing timeline: mitigation successful via cross-region traffic shift and provider route fix. will run RCA and add DNS/egress jitter checks to runbook.

carla: moving to post-incident mode — will draft comms and link to RCA once ready. thank you all. :thumbsup:
